document: DS14721 Rev 2 - Table 67. WLCSP15 - Example of PCB design rules
title: Table 67. WLCSP15 - Example of PCB design rules
text_helper: Table 67. WLCSP15 - Example of PCB design rules — section 6.1 Device marking. Dimension, Recommended values.

notes: 1. Values in inches are converted from mm and rounded to four decimal digits.
2. Dimension “D” does not include mold flash, protrusions or gate burrs. Mold flash, protrusions or gate burrs shall not exceed 0.15 mm per side.
3. Dimension “E1” does not include interlead flash or protrusions. Interlead flash or protrusions shall not exceed 0.25 mm per side.
